content.short: bWorks is Catalyst funded project for Cardano smart contract base HR platform to find best jobs for job seekers and best matched job seekers to posted jobs.
content.description:
bWorks is seamless decentralized HR platform that funded by Cardano catalyst project built on Cardano blockchain network. Our missions: Find best matched freelancers for a job. Find best matched jobs for a freelancer. Eliminate fake jobs and fraud job applications. Guarantee the payment through Cardano smart contract. Project Github: Application repo, smart contract repo. Application: https://bworks.app ‍ We are looking to collaborate with other partners to grow users, improve the product quality and extend new features.
